colophon.subtitle.en: How this small museum was put together.
colophon.subtitle.zh: 这座小陈列馆是怎么搭起来的。

colophon.idea.body.en: Almost everything I make ends up as a small world: a music box with an opera house inside, a tin for little things, a garden that keeps its own calendar, a scroll you walk through with a lantern. So I laid this site out like a museum. The works stand on an arc under one light, numbered like lots in an auction catalogue, and each one gets a wall label that says what it is made of. One room holds things you can play; another holds things that think.
colophon.idea.body.zh: 我做的东西，最后大多成了一个小世界：一只装着歌剧院的音乐盒，一个收小东西的铁盒，一座有自己花历的花园，一幅要提着灯走进去的画卷。所以我把这个网站布置成一座陈列馆：作品在一束光下沿着弧线排开，像拍卖图录一样编号，每件配一张展签，写着它是用什么做成的。一间展厅放可以玩的东西，另一间放会思考的东西。

colophon.type.intro.en: Six typefaces, all under open licenses.
colophon.type.intro.zh: 六款字体，全部是开源授权。

colophon.type.cormorant.en: Display. Headlines and the gallery title.
colophon.type.cormorant.zh: 标题。首页大标题和各个展厅的标题。

colophon.type.dmsans.en: Text. Everything you read at length.
colophon.type.dmsans.zh: 正文。所有需要慢慢读的文字。

colophon.type.compagnon.en: Museum labels. Lot numbers, dates and small captions.
colophon.type.compagnon.zh: 展签。编号、日期和小字说明。

colophon.type.xiangcui.en: Chinese display. It loads only in Chinese, and only the characters this site uses.
colophon.type.xiangcui.zh: 中文标题。只在中文模式下加载，而且只包含本站用到的字。

colophon.details.lantern.en: In the gallery, your pointer is a lantern: the light follows it.
colophon.details.lantern.zh: 展厅里，你的鼠标就是一盏灯，光会跟着它走。

colophon.details.lots.en: Lots are numbered newest first, in the order I made them.
colophon.details.lots.zh: 展品按我做它们的时间编号，最新的在最前面。

colophon.details.lights.en: Between the gallery and the reading rooms, the lights come up.
colophon.details.lights.zh: 从展厅走进阅读室的时候，灯会慢慢亮起来。

colophon.details.moon.en: The loader is a small moon walking through its phases in steps, a nod to the hand-made jitter in 1001 States of the Moon.
colophon.details.moon.zh: 加载提示是一枚一格一格走过月相的小月亮，致敬《月亮的一千零一种状态》里的手作抖动。

colophon.details.walk.en: The footer keeps count of how far you have scrolled today, at 1,000 pixels to the meter.
colophon.details.walk.zh: 页脚会记下你今天滚动了多远，1,000 像素算 1 米。

colophon.details.irisy.en: If you would rather ask than read, Irisy, my digital twin, waits in the corner.
colophon.details.irisy.zh: 不想读的话，右下角的 Irisy 是我的数字分身，可以直接问她。

colophon.built.body.en: Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with no framework. Words live in Markdown and JSON, and a few small Node scripts turn them into pages. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. I build it with Claude Code and Codex as collaborators.
colophon.built.body.zh: 手写的 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，没有用框架。文字放在 Markdown 和 JSON 里，几个小小的 Node 脚本把它们变成页面。网站托管在 GitHub Pages 上。我和 Claude Code、Codex 一起搭它。

colophon.credits.body.en: The covers are screenshots of my own works. All fonts are used under the SIL Open Font License; the license ships with the site.
colophon.credits.body.zh: 封面都是我自己作品的截图。所有字体都按 SIL 开源字体许可使用，许可文件随网站一起发布。
